summary: Enhance your skills in business analytics and reporting with our comprehensive training in Microsoft Excel and Power BI. Unlock data-driven insights today!
lede: Business analytics and reporting with Microsoft Excel and Power BI helps you turn inconsistent operational data into reliable measures, forecasts, explanations, and decision-ready reports. You will learn to prepare datasets, model relationships, define governed KPIs, interpret trends and exceptions, and communicate recommendations through accessible dashboards. This course provides hands-on practice with Power Query, Power Pivot, DAX, Excel What-If Analysis, forecast evaluation using MAE and MAPE, Power BI report design, row-level security, and source-to-report quality checks. You will follow the journey from raw data to a validated dashboard and executive insight summary, with conceptual or operational coverage of Copilot, Power Automate, Office Scripts, gateways, and enterprise deployment.
audienceIntro: This business analytics and reporting course is designed for professionals who work directly with operational data, recurring reports, forecasts, KPI reviews, and management dashboards. It is particularly relevant when you need to replace fragile spreadsheet processes with governed Excel models and Power BI reporting workflows.
modules: Excel and Power BI Analytics Foundations
Power Query Data Preparation and Governance
Excel Data Model and Power Pivot
Power BI Visual Analytics and Design
Power BI KPI Dashboards and Storytelling
Power BI Service Security and Collaboration
prerequisites: Required equipment: Bring a laptop capable of running current desktop editions of Microsoft Excel and Power BI Desktop. Install both applications before the course and confirm that you can open provided Excel workbooks and Power BI files. Licensing: Excel requires an appropriate Microsoft 365 or desktop licence. Power BI Desktop is available without a paid desktop licence, while publishing, organizational sharing, Copilot, and some service capabilities may require commercial licensing and administrator approval. Technical level: General programming is not required. DAX formulas and Power Query transformations form part of the hands-on work, while Office Scripts, Power Automate, AI-assisted analysis, gateways, and enterprise architecture receive conceptual or operational coverage.
